verify.name: PNG files are parseable prototype assets
verify.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
assets = {
    'background_section_one_v1': {'min_w': 640, 'min_h': 360, 'alpha_required': False},
    'background_section_two_v1': {'min_w': 640, 'min_h': 360, 'alpha_required': False},
    'player_avatar_v1': {'min_w': 128, 'min_h': 128, 'alpha_required': True},
    'ground_platform_tile_v1': {'min_w': 128, 'min_h': 128, 'alpha_required': True},
    'collectible_progression_item_v1': {'min_w': 128, 'min_h': 128, 'alpha_required': True},
    'hazard_warning_marker_v1': {'min_w': 128, 'min_h': 128, 'alpha_required': True},
    'goal_marker_v1': {'min_w': 128, 'min_h': 128, 'alpha_required': True},
    'ui_status_panel_v1': {'min_w': 256, 'min_h': 96, 'alpha_required': True},
}
for asset_id, rule in assets.items():
    path = f'game/assets/phase4b/direct_art/{asset_id}.png'
    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
        sig = f.read(8)
        assert sig == b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n', path
        length = struct.unpack('>I', f.read(4))[0]
        chunk = f.read(4)
        assert chunk == b'IHDR', path
        data = f.read(length)
        width, height, bit_depth, color_type = struct.unpack('>IIBB', data[:10])[:4]
        assert width >= rule['min_w'] and height >= rule['min_h'], (path, width, height)
        if rule['alpha_required']:
            assert color_type in (4, 6), (path, 'expected alpha-capable PNG color type', color_type)
print('png ok')
PY

human_decision_reason: BK/Human Creative Owner must approve, redirect, or reject the newly produced prototype art assets before any implementation Work Package may replace the current placeholder/reused visuals with them.
acceptance_criteria: Art Agent directly produces the full Phase 4B prototype art resource set: two section backgrounds, player avatar, ground/platform tile, collectible/progression item, hazard readability marker or obstacle cue, goal marker, and UI status panel art.

The default generation path is the Codex imagegen skill using built-in image_gen, because BK already has ChatGPT Pro access; ordinary generation must not require OPENAI_API_KEY or a paid Adobe workflow.

For sprite-like transparent assets, the default path is built-in image_gen on a removable flat chroma-key background followed by local chroma-key removal with the imagegen helper; CLI true-transparency fallback requires explicit BK approval.

Adobe Firefly or another paid/professional art tool may be recommended as a quality fallback or final production pass option, but WP-036 must not make it a hard dependency or incur a new subscription without explicit BK approval.
At least eight new PNG assets are produced under game/assets/phase4b/direct_art/**, with matching .png.import files after Godot import.
Each produced asset is gameplay-readable at prototype scale and is not final production art; sprite-like gameplay assets must have alpha-capable PNG format, while backgrounds may be opaque.
The two backgrounds must help distinguish Section 1 warmup from Section 2 hazard/item without becoming a full final environment painting or implying a different game concept.
The player asset must read as the controllable character without adding new movement verbs, weapons, combat, health, lives, or character-story commitments.
The ground/platform tile must support traversal readability without implying slopes, moving platforms, destructible terrain, or a tileset production system.
The collectible asset must not look like a goal, hazard, enemy, currency economy item, or final reward system.
The hazard asset must read as danger or avoidance support without implying enemy AI, combat, health, lives, damage systems, or moving-platform scope.
The goal marker must read as the destination and must not be confused with the collectible or hazard.
The UI status panel art must support start/status/result/retry readability without becoming a full menu, settings, save system, or branded HUD direction.
Prompts, tool/model identity, generation date, source/output mapping, license or usage uncertainty, and prototype-only status are recorded for each asset.

Each asset records whether it is prototype-only, production-candidate, or production-approved; imagegen output alone cannot be marked production-approved without separate BK review and, if needed, human art final pass.
Godot import metadata for the new PNG files is generated or confirmed, while game/.godot/** remains ignored and is not used as evidence.
A Korean owner review brief is created so BK can approve, redirect, or reject the generated assets without reading raw JSON.
No Godot scene, script, project config, Phase 3 assets, schemas, profiles, QA reviews, Learning Cards, lifecycle moves, staging, committing, or pushing are performed by WP-036 execution.
The result is a direct Art production capability test and does not approve final art direction, production/public asset usage, launch readiness, web export, or external testing.
notes: This Work Package intentionally differs from WP-032. WP-032 tested Art Agent reuse packaging. WP-036 tests direct prototype art production by requiring a full newly produced Phase 4B prototype art resource set, including backgrounds, gameplay sprites, platform/readability art, goal, and UI support art, plus prompt/tool/license evidence and a Korean owner review surface. The preferred execution path is the Codex imagegen skill with built-in image_gen because BK has ChatGPT Pro access; transparent sprite output should use chroma-key generation plus local removal first. Adobe or other paid tools are quality fallback/final-pass options only, not hard dependencies. If no acceptable image generation or editing path is available, WP-036 should be marked blocked rather than replaced with prose-only mock assets.
